name: Scroll Wave Slider
description: Draggable horizontal strip of tall image cards pinned to the bottom of the screen. Cards grow in a smooth wave as they pass the center, with inertia after release.
contents: Row of numbered image cards with uppercase labels
behavior: Drag with the pointer to scroll horizontally, with momentum and friction on release
Cards widen as they cross the center using a CSS view-timeline scroll animation
Images are shown with grayscale and contrast filters
Scrollbar is hidden and cursor switches to grabbing while dragging
editableByProps: Cards, labels, links, images and alt text
Card sizes, expanded size, gap, aspect ratio and padding
Image filter strength, background color, label size and weight, drag friction

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the wave easing curve of the card expansion
Place the strip in the page flow instead of the bottom of the screen
needsCodeEdit.where: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 classes on the root div

fixed: Strip is pinned to the bottom of the viewport with fixed positioning
Card expansion uses CSS animation-timeline view(), which needs a browser that supports scroll-driven animations
Text color is inherited from the page
